name: intercity-bus-booking-ai
description: Student microservices project for intercity bus booking with AI and MCP Server

scripts.dev: echo "Run individual workspaces: dev:web, dev:gateway, dev:trip, dev:booking, dev:ticket-worker, dev:email-worker."
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -s first -n "gateway,web,trip,booking,payment,seat,seat-consumer,ticket,email" -c "magenta,cyan,yellow,green,yellow,blue,red,gray,white" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:trip" "npm run dev:booking" "npm run dev:payment" "npm run dev:seat" "npm run dev:seat-consumer" "npm run dev:ticket-worker" "npm run dev:email-worker"
scripts.dev:all: npm run infra:up && npm run dev:services
scripts.dev:reset: npm run infra:reset && npm run install:all && npm run audit:fix && npm run dev:all
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:gateway && npm run test:booking
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:gateway:integration && npm run test:seat:integration
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.validate: npm run check:docs && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
